baroque_clarinet.description: 2-key Denner-style baroque clarinet c.1700. 7 finger holes + 2 keys.

bass_clarinet_7hole.description: 7-hole D major diatonic bass clarinet. 0.04c RMS 1st register, 7.96c RMS 2nd register.

bass_chalumeau_C.description: Historical bass chalumeau (Kress/Denner type). 8 holes + 2 keys. Range C3-G4.

pvc_flute_D.description: 6-hole transverse flute from 3/4" PVC Sch40. Fundamental D4 (293.7 Hz).

soprano_sax_Bb.description: 7-hole soprano sax template. Conical bore approximated. Requires optimization.

alto_sax_Eb.description: 7-hole alto sax template. Requires optimization for intonation.

koncovka_C.description: Slovak overtone flute. No holes. Fundamental C3 (130.8 Hz).

xaphoon_C.description: Brian's Xaphoon pocket sax. 7 holes, clarinet-like fingering. 300mm.

glissotar.description: Glissando reed, conical bore 16-36mm. 9 holes, slide glissando.

fujara_G.description: Traditional Slovak fujara. 1.75m. Fundamental G1 (49 Hz).

overtone_flute_G.description: Closed-end overtone flute. 214mm, 13 harmonics. G4 (392 Hz).

clarinet_Eb.description: Eb clarinet, highest standard clarinet. Pitched minor 3rd above Bb. Bright, piercing.

clarinet_Bb_modern.description: Standard 14-hole Boehm Bb clarinet. Most common clarinet worldwide.

clarinet_A.description: A clarinet, slightly longer than Bb. Warmer tone, orchestral standard.

bass_clarinet_Bb_standard.description: Standard 10-hole bass clarinet. Bore 23.5mm, range Bb1-C4.

contraalto_clarinet_Eb.description: Contra-alto clarinet. One octave below alto sax. Powerful low register.

contrabass_clarinet_Bb.description: Contrabass clarinet. One octave below bass. Deepest clarinet.

soprano_sax_Bb_std.description: Standard soprano sax. Conical 12-22mm. Straight body.

alto_sax_Eb_std.description: Standard alto sax. Most popular saxophone. 9 main tone holes.

tenor_sax_Bb_std.description: Standard tenor sax. Rich, full tone. Jazz, classical, pop.

baritone_sax_Eb_std.description: Standard bari sax. Powerful low register. Low A key omitted.

bass_sax_Bb.description: Bass saxophone. Very large. Rare in modern ensembles.

piccolo.description: Highest standard orchestral flute. Sounds octave above concert flute.

concert_flute_C.description: Standard concert flute. 11 holes with Boehm key system.

alto_flute_G.description: Alto flute in G. Warmer, darker tone than concert flute.

bass_flute_C.description: Bass flute, octave below concert. Curved headjoint.

soprano_recorder_C.description: Standard soprano (descant) recorder. Most common recorder. Fipple flute.

alto_recorder_F.description: Alto recorder in F. Most used in consort and solo repertoire.

tenor_recorder_C.description: Tenor recorder in C. Warm, mellow tone.

bass_recorder_F.description: Bass recorder in F. Large bore, warm deep tone.

oboe_standard.description: Conservatory oboe. Narrow conical bore 3-11.5mm. Complex key system.

english_horn_F.description: English horn in F. Lower, warmer than oboe. Bulbous bell not modeled.

baroque_oboe.description: Baroque 2-key oboe. Narrower bore than modern. Richer, intimate tone.

bassoon_standard.description: Standard Heckel bassoon. Conical 12-34mm. Bocal omitted.

contrabassoon.description: Contrabassoon. Doubled-back bore ~4.7m. Deepest standard woodwind.

trumpet_Bb.description: Bb trumpet. Mostly cylindrical. Bell/valves omitted.

cornet_Bb.description: Bb cornet. More conical than trumpet. Warmer, mellower.

french_horn_F.description: Single F horn. ~3.7m tubing. Bell/rotary valves omitted.

trombone_Bb.description: Tenor trombone. Mostly cylindrical. Slide not modeled.

tuba_Bb.description: Bb tuba. Large conical bore. Deepest standard brass. Valves omitted.

cornett_G.description: Renaissance cornett. Lip-reed + finger holes. Conical, curved wood body.

shawm_Bb.description: Medieval shawm. Loud double-reed. Conical with flared bell. 7-8 holes.

dulcian_Bb.description: Renaissance dulcian. Double-bore (simplified as single cone). Bassoon predecessor.

baroque_flute_D.description: Baroque 1-key traverso in D. Conical bore, 8 holes. Warm, soft tone.

classical_flute_C.description: Early classical 4-key flute. Conical bore with larger foot joint.

tin_whistle_D.description: 6-hole D5 tin whistle. Slightly conical. Simple folk instrument.

ocarina_12.description: 12-hole transverse ocarina. Vessel resonator. Simplified as disc.

didgeridoo.description: Australian Aboriginal drone. Hollowed eucalyptus. Lips vibrate.

alphorn_F.description: Alpine natural horn in F. ~3.4m conical. Harmonic series only.

pvc_bass_clarinet.description: DIY bass clarinet from 1-1/4" PVC. 7 holes.

glissonardo.description: 3D-printed soprano sax. Conical bore, glissando. JDWoodwinds.

seljefloyte.description: Norwegian willow flute. 5 holes, no fipple. Pentatonic.

tilinca.description: Romanian fipple flute. 5-6 holes. Pentatonic, pastoral.

tarogato.description: Hungarian tarogato. Conical like soprano sax, clarinet reed. Hybrid.
